name: Dadao - EVC Project (Updated)
author: Raundt
description:
Move with WASD or Arrow Keys, Jump with Spacebar and Slide with holding S or DOWN while running to get a movement speed multiplier. Avoid enemies (cant be killed for now). 

Dadao is a project I develop for an university subject called EVC. I work alone on it and have other subjects that require a lot of attention, so I can only slowly improve on it, but nevertheless any feedback is welcome and I already improved on the feedback I’ve got. Dadao now consists of 9 levels with increasing difficulty. All of them are possible if you get the right mechanic. Have fun!
